title: 大好きな彼女は 僕の上司、同期、後輩… 誰にでも股開く 社内共有マ●コでした。 でも…悔し勃起しちゃう無様な僕。 村上悠華
maker: エスワン ナンバーワンスタイル
label: S1 NO.1 STYLE
synopsis: 悠華 was my girlfriend from the same workplace、someone I was proud of beyond what a mismatch like me deserved。Beautiful、great figure、bright、and friendly with everyone...。Her popularity among the men in the company was exceptional。My irritating middle-aged boss、my close coworker、and the junior who had just joined。She got along well with everyone、and I respected her for that…。But、behind that popularity、I understood nothing。As for 悠華、she was having wild sex with every one of them。Right next to me as I was overwhelmed with work、she slept with the men in the office far too easily、seeming to enjoy it。「Fight back more……。Why are you、having sex so happily……」Frustrating。Frustrating。Sad。Painful。Even though it should be...。For some reason、my crotch was growing hot。「I’m sorry I cheated」「But why is your penis getting bigger？」Ah、why am I getting erect、I...。
